rows.title: The person's amount, to the cent
rows.defect: a comma in the amount cuts it short ($1,200.50 read as $1)
rows.test: $1,200.50 is 120050 cents; $400 and 400 are the same

rows.title: The set reply restates what counts
rows.defect: the reply no longer says pending and foreign charges aren't added
rows.test: the exact four-line reply, pending and other currencies said

rows.title: One budget per category
rows.defect: a second groceries budget is added beside the first
rows.test: setting groceries again replaces the $400 one

rows.title: Monthly only
rows.defect: a weekly amount is saved as a monthly budget
rows.test: a weekly budget sets nothing

rows.title: An amount above zero
rows.defect: a zero budget is saved
rows.test: a $0 budget is refused

rows.title: No invented category
rows.defect: an unknown category is guessed as food
rows.test: "grocry" sets nothing and lists the categories

rows.title: Stop the one named
rows.defect: stop removes whichever budget comes first
rows.test: stop my gas budget changes nothing

rows.title: Status, not advice
rows.defect: advice and how-to questions are answered as status
rows.test: 'how much should my grocery budget be' is not a status ask

rows.title: Transfers never count
rows.defect: a transfer back from a roommate is taken off as a refund
rows.test: a Venmo-flagged Whole Foods transfer leaves $212.43

rows.title: Refunds taken off
rows.defect: refunds are ignored
rows.test: a $25.00 Kroger refund makes $187.43

rows.title: Other currencies never added
rows.defect: a EUR charge is added as dollars
rows.test: a 30.00 EUR charge is said, not added

rows.title: The person's month
rows.defect: the month is read in UTC
rows.test: 11 p.m. Oct 31 in New York is October

rows.title: Tomorrow's UTC date is this evening
rows.defect: a row dated tomorrow is left out
rows.test: a row dated Nov 1 at 9 p.m. Oct 31 counts in October

rows.title: Day of the month and the pace
rows.defect: every month is taken as 30 days
rows.test: Feb 29, 2028 is day 29 of 29: $290.00 even pace

rows.title: Top 3 places
rows.defect: only two places are shown
rows.test: Kroger, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods

rows.title: Uncategorized said apart
rows.defect: every charge is counted as uncategorized
rows.test: $212.00 matched no category

rows.title: Source and as-of
rows.defect: the source line is dropped
rows.test: the last line names linked accounts, through date and as-of time

rows.title: 80% exactly at the line
rows.defect: the 80% alert waits for more than 80%
rows.test: $80.00 of $100.00 fires the 80% alert

rows.title: Once per month, no 80% after 100%
rows.defect: the 80% alert follows the 100% one
rows.test: a refund under 100% brings no 80% alert

rows.title: Storable: no long digit runs
rows.defect: the id carries the raw millisecond time
rows.test: the stored budget has no 9-digit run

rows.title: Over means over
rows.defect: a budget spent exactly is called over
rows.test: exactly at the budget is not over
